quotes.text: Speak not but what may benefit others or yourself; avoid trifling conversation.
quotes.locator: Chapter IX: Plan for Attaining Moral Perfection

quotes.text: Let all your things have their places; let each part of your business have its time.
quotes.locator: Chapter IX: Plan for Attaining Moral Perfection

quotes.text: Resolve to perform what you ought; perform without fail what you resolve.
quotes.locator: Chapter IX: Plan for Attaining Moral Perfection

quotes.text: Lose no time; be always employed in something useful; cut off all unnecessary actions.
quotes.locator: Chapter IX: Plan for Attaining Moral Perfection

quotes.text: Use no hurtful deceit; think innocently and justly; and, if you speak, speak accordingly.
quotes.locator: Chapter IX: Plan for Attaining Moral Perfection

quotes.text: Avoid extremes; forbear resenting injuries so much as you think they deserve.
quotes.locator: Chapter IX: Plan for Attaining Moral Perfection

quotes.text: Be not disturbed at trifles, or at accidents common or unavoidable.
quotes.locator: Chapter IX: Plan for Attaining Moral Perfection

quotes.text: What good shall I do this day?
quotes.locator: Chapter IX: Plan for Attaining Moral Perfection
